white_bright: The eye whites in `image` are brighter / whiter and cleaner than in `reference_image`.
white_big: Too much eye white shows in `image` compared with `reference_image`.
iris_small: The irises in `image` are smaller relative to the eye opening than in `reference_image`.
iris_flat: The irises in `image` look flat or glassy-cartoon instead of painted with a dark upper part and a dark rim.
pupil_odd: The pupils in `image` have an odd shape (slit, notch or keyhole).
lash_thin: The upper lash line in `image` is thinner or lighter than in `reference_image`.
lash_flick: The upper lash in `image` ends in a VRoid-style flick or hook at the outer corner.
lower_lid: The lower lid line in `image` is missing or weaker than in `reference_image`.
shape_tilted: The eye openings in `image` are more tilted / almond-cat shaped than in `reference_image`.
shape_flat_top: The upper lid in `image` is flatter (less arched) than in `reference_image`.
brows_far: The eyebrows in `image` sit further above the eyes than in `reference_image`.
brows_hatch: The eyebrows in `image` show regular stripes or hatching that `reference_image` does not have.
crease_missing: `image` lacks the upper-lid crease line that `reference_image` has.
